summary.en: Command-line file transfer client for FTP, SFTP, S3 and cloud storage. The release ships duck-9.6.0.46406-arm64.msi.
summary.zh-TW: 支援 FTP、SFTP、S3 與雲端儲存的命令列檔案傳輸工具，版本提供 duck-9.6.0.46406-arm64.msi。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
